detail:
WHAT
The first post that tells people the event is coming.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Launch event announcement: publish event identity, date, venue/area, value proposition and registration/ticket CTA.”

STEPS
1. Post the launch post (done Sun 15 Nov).
2. Ticket link and venue come later, when Rashad says.

DELIVER
The live post link

DONE WHEN
Posted.

WHAT
One calendar from now to after the event: every post, reel, story, countdown, FAQ and reminder, each with a date and an owner.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Create master content calendar: announcement, launch, vendor reveals, sponsor posts, activities, countdowns, FAQs and final reminders.”

STEPS
1. Start from the [[sched|🗓️ Schedule]]: it has every post and reel.
2. Add the stories for each day (countdowns, polls, “New post” stories, FAQs, reminders).
3. Give every line a date and one owner.
4. Send it to Rashad. When he approves, the Schedule is updated from it.

DELIVER
Calendar (sheet or Canva link) uploaded here

DONE WHEN
Every date has an owner and Rashad approved it.
deliverable: Calendar (sheet or Canva link) uploaded here

detail:
WHAT
Instagram and TikTok look finished: bio, link, highlights, contact method and event info.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Optimize social profiles: update bio, links, highlights, contact method, registration link and event information.”

STEPS
1. Wait for Rashad to confirm the handle and the bio text before changing anything.
2. Instagram: bio, link in bio, contact button, highlight covers (from Jana's templates).
3. TikTok: Business account with the same photo, name and bio.
4. Send Rashad screenshots of both profiles.

DELIVER
Screenshots of both profiles

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved both profiles.

NOTE
Passwords stay with Rashad. Never put them on this site.

WHAT
Templates the whole team uses, plus the event hashtags and how we write.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Finalize event identity: lock logo, colors, typography, templates, tone, hashtags and sponsor branding rules.”

STEPS
1. Read [[brand|🎨 Brand]] first.
2. Make in Canva: feed post 1080×1440, story 1080×1920, reel cover, highlight covers.
3. Suggest one English and one Arabic hashtag (Rashad and the founders choose).
4. Write 3 lines on our tone (how captions sound).
5. Share the Canva folder with Suhad and Mohammed and add the link in [[board|📁 Board]].

DELIVER
Canva link + hashtags + tone lines

DONE WHEN
Suhad and Rashad approved them.

RULES
• Colours, fonts and logo: [[brand|🎨 Brand]] (Blue #7C98A3, Cream #E2D9BD, black, white; Impact / Farah).
• Dates big. Nothing off-theme (no palms, suns, flowers, balls, stars).
• Venue name stays hidden until Rashad says the reveal is out.

WHAT
One page that says who we talk to, what we say, in which phases, on which channels, and how we measure it.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Build marketing strategy: define audience, positioning, key message, campaign phases, content pillars, channels, KPIs and CTA.”

STEPS
1. Start from the media plan (open [[plan|📅 Plan]]).
2. Write: audience, key message, campaign phases (teaser → reveal → tickets → countdown → event → recap), content pillars, channels.
3. Add the numbers we aim for (followers, reach, ticket clicks) and the call to action of each phase.
4. Send it to Rashad. He sends it to the founders.

DELIVER
The strategy page (doc or PDF)

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved it.

WHAT
The plan for our main ad (posts Sat 5 Dec): script, storyboard, shot list, who approves.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Create promo video concept: write script/storyboard, shot list, talent/location/product requirements and approval flow.”

STEPS
1. Read the promo card in [[plan|📅 Plan]] and the trend in the [[sched|🗓️ Schedule]].
2. Write the script (what is said or written on screen, second by second).
3. Draw a simple storyboard (one box per shot).
4. Write the shot list for the filming day (Wed 25 Nov): place, people, props.
5. Send it to Rashad and Suhad.

DELIVER
Script + storyboard + shot list

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved it before the filming day.

WHAT
What went out this week and what is late.

STEPS
1. List what was posted this week (from the [[sched|🗓️ Schedule]]).
2. List what is late and its new date.
3. Add the main numbers from Instagram insights.
4. Send it to Rashad. Rashad sends it to the founders.

DELIVER
Summary text

DONE WHEN
Rashad has it by Sunday night.

NOTE
Founders' meeting rule (9 Nov): a weekly summary every week.

WHAT
The plan for polls, Q&A, countdowns, activity reveals, the guess-the-venue hints and people's own posts (UGC), up to the event.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Build engagement campaign: polls, Q&A, countdowns, activity reveals, UGC prompts and reminders.”

STEPS
1. List the engagement items already in the [[sched|🗓️ Schedule]].
2. Add the countdown stickers and the question boxes with their dates.
3. Write the rules of the guess-the-venue contest for Rashad to approve (prize, how to answer, how winners are picked).
4. Send it to Rashad.

DELIVER
Engagement plan

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved it.

WHAT
Film the promo video at the venue on the filming day, from the approved shot list.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Shoot promo video: capture planned footage with backup shots and releases/permissions where needed.”

STEPS
1. Take the approved shot list.
2. Film every shot twice, vertical 9:16, plus a few horizontal.
3. Film backup shots.
4. Anyone who appears agreed to be filmed. Nothing that shows the venue name before the reveal.
5. Upload all raw clips to [[board|📁 Board]] the same night.

DELIVER
Link to the raw clips folder

DONE WHEN
Every shot on the list is filmed and uploaded.
deliverable: Link to the raw clips folder

detail:
WHAT
Which posts we boost, to whom, with what budget and on which dates.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Plan paid advertising: audience, budget, creative variations, campaign dates, tracking and daily performance checks.”

STEPS
1. Pick the posts to boost from the [[sched|🗓️ Schedule]] (teaser, promo, tickets).
2. Audience: Jeddah, ages, interests.
3. Budget per post: ask Rashad (Finance decides).
4. How we check results every day.

DELIVER
Ads plan (one page)

DONE WHEN
Rashad and Finance approved it.

WHAT
Everything we need the day tickets open: graphics, FAQ, prices, terms wording, payment confirmation text.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Prepare ticket sales assets: ticket page graphics, FAQs, pricing, terms, payment confirmation and refund/cancellation wording.”

STEPS
1. Design the ticket post and story (prices left blank until Rashad confirms them).
2. Suhad writes the FAQ and the short terms/refund wording from the tickets site.
3. Get it ready, do not post: the date comes when the tickets platform is live.

DELIVER
Designs + FAQ text

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved them.

RULES
• Colours, fonts and logo: [[brand|🎨 Brand]] (Blue #7C98A3, Cream #E2D9BD, black, white; Impact / Farah).
• Dates big. Nothing off-theme (no palms, suns, flowers, balls, stars).
• Venue name stays hidden until Rashad says the reveal is out.

WHAT
How we collect each vendor's logo, description, photos and offer, get their approval, and post them.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Create vendor spotlight process: collect vendor logo, description, product photos, offers and approval; schedule spotlight content.”

STEPS
1. Make a short form or sheet: logo, one-line description, 3 photos, offer, Instagram handle.
2. Jana prepares the Participant post template.
3. Agree with PR & Logistics who sends it to the vendors.
4. Spotlights go in the [[sched|🗓️ Schedule]] once vendors are confirmed.

DELIVER
Form/sheet + Participant template

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved the process.

WHAT
Logos, brand rules, copy and required placements from every confirmed sponsor.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Collect sponsor assets: logos, brand guidelines, copy, activation details and required placements.”

STEPS
1. Ask Rashad / Finance for the confirmed sponsors list.
2. Collect logo files, their brand rules, the text they want and where they must appear.
3. Save everything in [[board|📁 Board]].

DELIVER
Sponsor folder

DONE WHEN
Every confirmed sponsor has its files.

NOTE
Starts when Finance confirms sponsors.

WHAT
Local pages, creators and community accounts that could share the event, plus the message and a media kit.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Create media/press outreach list: local pages, creators, community accounts and relevant media; outreach message and media kit.”

STEPS
1. List Jeddah pages and creators that fit (name, handle, followers).
2. Write the outreach message.
3. Make a one-page media kit (what, when, activities, logo).

DELIVER
List + message + media kit

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved; nothing is sent before that.

WHAT
Same as last week.

STEPS
1. Posted / late / numbers.
2. Send to Rashad.

DELIVER
Summary text

DONE WHEN
Rashad has it by Sunday night.

WHAT
Final promo video for Instagram and TikTok, with captions, subtitles and the call to action.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Edit promo video: produce platform versions, captions, subtitles and final CTA.”

STEPS
1. Edit from the approved script; trend and example in the [[sched|🗓️ Schedule]].
2. Versions: 9:16 reel and a short cut.
3. Subtitles (Arabic + English), logo end card with the dates.
4. Submit here for Rashad to approve.

DELIVER
Final video files

DONE WHEN
Approved in [[review|Review]] before Thu 3 Dec.

RULES
• Colours, fonts and logo: [[brand|🎨 Brand]] (Blue #7C98A3, Cream #E2D9BD, black, white; Impact / Farah).
• Dates big. Nothing off-theme (no palms, suns, flowers, balls, stars).
• Venue name stays hidden until Rashad says the reveal is out.

task: All December content ready before exams
detail:
WHAT
Every December post and reel in the Schedule is designed and approved, because the groups stop during exams.

STEPS
1. Check every December item in the [[sched|🗓️ Schedule]].
2. Submit each one here or in its task.
3. Suhad checks nothing is missing.

DELIVER
Everything submitted

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved all December items.

WHAT
Same as last week.

STEPS
1. Posted / late / numbers.
2. Send to Rashad.

DELIVER
Summary text

DONE WHEN
Rashad has it by Sunday night.

WHAT
Every shot we need on event day: venue, crowd, zones, vendors, sponsors, activities, leadership, safety, closing, short interviews.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Create event-day shot list.”

STEPS
1. Walk through the floor plan zone by zone.
2. List the shots for each zone and each time of day.
3. Mark the sponsor shots (they are needed for the sponsor report).

DELIVER
Shot list

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved it.

WHAT
Where every sponsor appears: banners, screens, mentions, booths and posts.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Map sponsor placements.”

STEPS
1. Take the sponsor list and what each one bought (Finance).
2. Mark each placement on the floor plan and in the [[sched|🗓️ Schedule]].
3. Check with Logistics and Organization.

DELIVER
Placement map

DONE WHEN
Finance and Rashad approved it.

WHAT
The event signs (zones, directions, booths, rules) designed for printing.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“(PR & Logistics sheet) Produce operational signage, support: Marketing.”

STEPS
1. Get the list of signs and sizes from Logistics.
2. Design them on the brand templates.
3. Submit for Rashad, then Logistics prints.

DELIVER
Print-ready files

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved; Logistics has the files.

RULES
• Colours, fonts and logo: [[brand|🎨 Brand]] (Blue #7C98A3, Cream #E2D9BD, black, white; Impact / Farah).
• Dates big. Nothing off-theme (no palms, suns, flowers, balls, stars).
• Venue name stays hidden until Rashad says the reveal is out.

WHAT
Same as last week.

STEPS
1. Posted / late / numbers.
2. Send to Rashad.

DELIVER
Summary text

DONE WHEN
Rashad has it by Sunday night.

WHAT
Who films which zone and when on both days, and how files are sent.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Create event-day content schedule.”

STEPS
1. Split both days into time blocks.
2. Give each block a person and zones.
3. Decide how files go to the editor (folder, every 2 hours).

DELIVER
Event-day schedule

DONE WHEN
Rashad and Organization approved it.

WHAT
Same as last week.

STEPS
1. Posted / late / numbers.
2. Send to Rashad.

DELIVER
Summary text

DONE WHEN
Rashad has it by Sunday night.

WHAT
Film opening, crowd, activities, vendors, sponsors, guests and behind the scenes on both days.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Capture live event content.”

STEPS
1. Follow the event-day shot list and schedule.
2. Upload clips every 2 hours.

DELIVER
Clips folder

DONE WHEN
Every shot on the list is filmed.

WHAT
Approved live updates without disturbing the work or showing anything restricted.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Post live stories/reels.”

STEPS
1. Stories every hour.
2. One reel per day.
3. Nothing posted that the founders or safety team said to keep private.

DELIVER
Live posts

DONE WHEN
Posted on both days.

WHAT
Photos and videos of every sponsor placement for the sponsor report.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Capture sponsor fulfillment evidence.”

STEPS
1. Use the sponsor placement map.
2. Photo + short video of each placement on day 1.
3. Save in the sponsor folder.

DELIVER
Sponsor proof folder

DONE WHEN
Every placement has proof.

WHAT
Event week summary.

STEPS
1. Posted / numbers.
2. Send to Rashad.

DELIVER
Summary text

DONE WHEN
Rashad has it by Sunday night.

WHAT
The recap of the two days (trend in the Schedule).

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Publish recap.”

STEPS
1. Pick the strongest clips.
2. Edit the recap reel and a longer version.
3. Submit for approval.

DELIVER
Recap video

DONE WHEN
Approved and posted.

WHAT
Reach, engagement, clicks, ticket sales from our links, ad spend and best posts.

FROM THE LEADERSHIP SHEET
“Create marketing performance report.”

STEPS
1. Take the numbers from Instagram, TikTok and the ads.
2. Show the top 5 posts.
3. What worked and what to change next time.

DELIVER
Report

DONE WHEN
Sent to Rashad.

task: This week's posts from the Schedule
detail:
WHAT
Make and hand in every post, reel and story the 🗓️ Schedule gives you this week (each one by its 'Submit by' date).

STEPS
1. Open [[sched|🗓️ Schedule]] and find this week's items with your name.
2. Follow the trend and the example link on each item.
3. Press 📤 Submit here for each one (file or link + caption). One submission per item.
4. Suhad checks and Rashad approves in [[review|Review]] before anything is posted.

DELIVER
One submission per Schedule item

DONE WHEN
Every item of the week is approved and posted on its day.

RULES
• Colours, fonts and logo: [[brand|🎨 Brand]] (Blue #7C98A3, Cream #E2D9BD, black, white; Impact / Farah).
• Dates big. Nothing off-theme (no palms, suns, flowers, balls, stars).
• Venue name stays hidden until Rashad says the reveal is out.
